D: A hotshot race car gets stuck in a forgotten Route 66 town on the way to a big race.
P: Serve the mains when Lightning pulls into Flo's café in Radiator Springs.
S: Small waffle cones filled with a cheesy corn and capsicum dip, baked at 180C for 8 minutes.
the motel built from traffic cones
Seasoned curly fries baked crisp and served in paper cones with aioli. Bake 1kg frozen curly fries at 220C for 20 minutes until crisp.
Corn cobs boiled 6 minutes, brushed with butter mixed with chilli and lime, and charred on a hot grill until blistered.

the old Route 66 through the desert
Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with kidney beans, chilli, cumin and tomato until thick, served with cornbread.

s.note: the motel built from traffic cones
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen curly fries at 220C for 20 minutes until crisp. Toss with 1 tsp smoked paprika and salt and serve in paper cones with 150g garlic aioli.

Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes, then drain. Mix 60g soft butter with a pinch of chilli flakes and the zest and juice of a lime. Brush over the corn and char on a hot grill, turning, until blistered all over. Brush with more butter to serve.

m.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into crinkle chips and fry twice until crisp. Shape 600g beef mince into 4 patties and grill, melting cheddar on top. Fry bacon and sliced onion until golden. Stack it all in toasted buns and serve with the fries.

w.how: Heat 150ml cream until steaming and pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate, stirring until glossy hot fudge. Scoop vanilla ice cream into tall glasses, pour over the fudge and top with whipped cream and a maraschino cherry. Winner takes all.

d.how: Pour cold cola into tall glasses, leaving room at the top. Gently add a scoop of vanilla ice cream to each so it fizzes and foams up dark like an oil can. Serve with a long spoon and a straw straight away.
